sentences.text: Shri Kunal Jain - Advocate for the petitioner.

Order 
This miscellaneous petition has been preferred by the petitioner under Article 227 of the Constitution of India, against the order dated 14.08.2024 passed in MACC No.173/2024 by I Member, MACT, District Khargone, whereby claim of the respondents/claimants has been entertained despite not filing within six months of occurrence of the incident.

2. Facts in brief are that a claim for compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 was filed on 28.06.2024 regarding the injuries occurred in motor vehicles accident dated 12.12.2023 alleging the application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that issue of limitation is under consideration before Hon'ble Apex Court for adjudication.

Therefore, Tribunal be directed not to pass final order in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:742 2 MP-7033-2024 MACC No.173/2024.
4.
I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and have perused the record.

5. In view of submission of learned counsel for the petitioner, it is directed that Tribunal shall proceed with the case, but it shall not pass final order in the case, till disposal of the issue of limitation before the Hon'ble Apex Court.
